items.label: Bracelet Design
items.value: This imported bangle watch for women boasts a cuffed bracelet design, featuring a classic and timeless aesthetic that complements various styles.

items.label: Stainless Steel Back Case
items.value: The watch is equipped with a stainless steel back case, ensuring durability and longevity, making it a reliable accessory for everyday wear.

items.label: Japanese Quartz Movement
items.value: Powered by Japanese quartz movement, this watch provides accurate and reliable timekeeping, enhancing the precision of your timepiece.

items.label: Mother-of-Pearl Face
items.value: The watch features a mother-of-pearl face, adding a touch of elegance and sophistication to the overall design.

items.label: Cuff Design
items.value: The beautiful open cuff watch is designed to expand, providing a comfortable fit for small to medium wrists measuring 6 to 7 inches.
